answer: Rooted reputation vine: a new identity must graft onto one established sponsor and share a slashable bond sized to that sponsor's last-epoch payout. Rewards climb the vine only after twenty honest epochs; one honeypot failure stamps a sable mark on the whole branch and freezes its payouts at their nadir until the bond is topped up. Farming a thousand sybils then means putting a thousand bonds at risk, not minting free accounts.
